notablePrerequisites:
Samite Blessing attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Samite Blessing ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
